svg.aria-label: Animated scene of the C++20 matching engine: orders enter a lock-free single-producer single-consumer ring buffer, a single-writer matching core updates a sorted-vector order book with O(1) cancels and emits partial fills to a trade tape, and a throughput bar grows from 13.7K to 3.81M operations per second, a 278 times improvement on cancel-heavy load.

g.text: // Matching engine · price-time priority, lock-free ingestion
single writer · no locks on the hot path
